Let me use the **transfer-matrix DP carefully**. Let $f_k(j, v)$ = number of ways to fill first $k$ digits with partial sum $j$ and last digit $v$, with no two adjacent equal so far. Doing this fully by hand over 7 positions and sums up to 30 with 10 digit values is enormous and error-prone.
